declaration.preface:
Solex Energy Limited is committed to maintaining a responsible, ethical, and transparent supply chain. The Company seeks to integrate environmental, social, ethical, and governance considerations into its supplier selection, evaluation, and management processes.

The Company expects its suppliers, contractors, and business partners to comply with applicable laws and regulations, uphold ethical business practices, respect human rights, provide safe working conditions, and minimize environmental impacts. Through responsible supplier management, due diligence, and ongoing engagement, Solex Energy Limited aims to promote sustainable business practices and strengthen the resilience and integrity of its supply chain.
declaration.scope:
This Policy applies to all employees of Solex Energy Limited involved in procurement, purchasing, sourcing, vendor selection, supplier management, and related activities.

Where applicable, the Policy also extends to suppliers, contractors, service providers, and other business partners engaged with the Company. It covers responsible supplier selection, evaluation, purchasing decisions, supplier engagement, ethical business practices, environmental considerations, human rights, labor standards, and compliance with applicable laws and Company requirements.

focusAreas: Labour, Human Rights & Health and Safety

Responsible Supplier Selection & Due Dil: Suppliers are selected, evaluated, and onboarded through fair, transparent, and risk-based processes that consider quality, technical capability, commercial suitability, legal compliance, and relevant environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors.
Maintain fair, transparent, and consistent supplier selection practices.
Consider quality, technical capability, commercial suitability, legal compliance, and relevant ESG factors in supplier selection.
Conduct appropriate due diligence before onboarding suppliers based on the nature of the supplier relationship.
Maintain appropriate documentation relating to supplier evaluation, approval, and onboarding.
Promote responsible business practices when selecting and managing key and strategically important suppliers.
Environmental Responsibility: Suppliers are encouraged to comply with applicable environmental requirements and adopt practices that support resource efficiency, pollution prevention, waste reduction, and responsible environmental management throughout the supply chain.
Consider relevant environmental factors in supplier evaluation and purchasing decisions.
Promote compliance with applicable environmental laws and regulations among suppliers.
Encourage suppliers to improve energy, water, material, and resource efficiency.
Promote waste reduction, pollution prevention, and responsible material management across the supply chain.
Encourage key suppliers to adopt environmentally responsible practices and identify opportunities for improvement.
Labour, Human Rights & Health and Safety: Suppliers and contractors are expected to uphold applicable labour and human rights standards, provide safe and healthy working conditions, prohibit child and forced labour, and promote fair treatment, non-discrimination, and worker dignity.
Promote respect for applicable labour and human rights requirements throughout the supply chain.
Prohibit child labour, forced labour, bonded labour, human trafficking, and other forms of labour exploitation within supplier relationships.
Promote fair, safe, and dignified working conditions among suppliers and relevant contractors.
Promote non-discrimination, respectful treatment, and applicable freedom of association rights.
Encourage relevant suppliers and contractors to maintain appropriate occupational health and safety practices.
Ethical & Legal Compliance: Employees and suppliers are expected to conduct business with integrity, transparency, and accountability while complying with applicable laws and regulations. Bribery, corruption, fraud, collusion, and conflicts of interest are prohibited.
Promote compliance with applicable laws and regulations throughout supplier relationships.
Maintain integrity, fairness, and transparency in procurement and supplier dealings.
Prohibit bribery, corruption, fraud, collusion, and other unethical business practices.
Promote appropriate identification and management of conflicts of interest in supplier-related activities.
Communicate relevant ethical, anti-bribery, anti-corruption, and responsible business requirements to suppliers.
Supplier Performance, Engagement & Conti: Establish appropriate processes for periodic supplier performance evaluation.
Monitor supplier performance relating to quality, delivery, service, compliance, and relevant ESG considerations.
Encourage suppliers to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
Periodically review and strengthen the Company's supplier management practices.

Solex Energy Limited may recognize high-performing suppliers that demonstrate excellence in quality, delivery, compliance, sustainability, innovation, and responsible business practices. Recognition may include preferred supplier status, long-term business opportunities, supplier appreciation certificates, recognition during supplier meetings or reviews, participation in strategic supplier programmes, and consideration for future sourcing opportunities. The Company aims to encourage continuous improvement and strengthen long-term partnerships with suppliers that consistently meet or exceed performance expectations.

responsibilities.duty: Provides overall oversight of supply chain governance, supplier-related risks, responsible sourcing practices, and the effectiveness of this Policy.

Provides leadership, resources, and accountability for implementation of this Policy and ensures that responsible supply chain considerations are integrated into procurement activities, supplier relationships, and business decision-making processes.

Leads the implementation of responsible supplier management practices, including supplier selection, screening, evaluation, due diligence, performance monitoring, and engagement. Ensures that relevant supplier requirements are incorporated into procurement processes and contractual arrangements and coordinates appropriate corrective actions for identified supplier risks or non-compliance.

Supports the integration of environmental, social, ethical, and governance considerations into supplier management processes and assists with supplier assessments, monitoring, training, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives. The Sustainability Officer shall annually review and update this Policy to reflect changes in applicable laws, regulations, Company procedures, procurement practices, supplier requirements, and identified sustainability risks.
Supports supplier evaluations, audits, risk assessments, compliance reviews, and performance monitoring relating to environmental, health, safety, and related compliance requirements.

Support the implementation of responsible supply chain requirements within their areas of responsibility, ensure that relevant employees receive appropriate information and training, and promote compliance with supplier management, due diligence, and responsible sourcing requirements.

responsibilities.role: Employees Involved in Procurement and Supplier Management
responsibilities.duty: Comply with applicable Company policies, procedures, and supplier management requirements; participate in required training; conduct supplier interactions with integrity and fairness; and promptly report supplier-related concerns, risks, or non-compliance.

Are expected to comply with applicable contractual obligations and relevant environmental, labour, human rights, health and safety, ethical, legal, and responsible business conduct requirements established by Solex Energy Limited.

policy.monitoring:
The effectiveness of supplier management and responsible sourcing programmes shall be periodically evaluated through supplier assessments, performance reviews, audits, compliance monitoring, corrective actions, supplier feedback, and other appropriate monitoring mechanisms.

Solex Energy Limited shall periodically monitor and report the performance of its green sourcing practices to evaluate progress, identify areas for improvement, and support informed decision-making.

Annual sourcing performance reporting shall cover relevant environmental, social, ethical, and supplier-related indicators, including:

Compliance with applicable sourcing requirements and the Supplier Code of Conduct.

Percentage of sustainable or environmentally preferable materials sourced.

Supplier assessment and performance results.

Progress on waste reduction, resource efficiency, and other relevant environmental objectives.

Identified gaps, risks, corrective actions, and improvement measures.

Performance shall be periodically reviewed through internal assessments or audits to evaluate the effectiveness of sourcing practices. The review shall cover:

Compliance with established sourcing processes and requirements.

Supplier performance and identified areas of concern.

Status of corrective and improvement actions.

Progress against defined sourcing and sustainability objectives.

Relevant feedback from employees, suppliers, customers, and other stakeholders shall be considered as part of performance evaluation. Key performance results, significant findings, improvement actions, and relevant changes in sourcing practices may be communicated through appropriate internal reports and sustainability disclosures.
policy.reviewMechanism:
The Sustainability Officer, in coordination with the Procurement Manager, shall review this Policy at least annually to assess its relevance and effectiveness. The review shall consider supplier performance, assessment and audit findings, compliance status, stakeholder feedback, corrective actions, and emerging supply chain risks.

The Policy shall be updated whenever required to reflect changes in applicable laws, regulations, Company procedures, procurement practices, supplier requirements, or identified environmental, social, ethical, and governance risks. Significant revisions shall be communicated to relevant employees and suppliers, as appropriate.
